title: The Writing Glitch Podcast - Videos
description:
This channel is designed to bring awareness about Dysgraphia and provide strategies to improve the types of dysgraphia.  The six types include visual-spatial, motor, memory, word formation, sentence formation, and paragraph formation.  We utilize a multi-sensory approach to improving handwriting struggles. 

#dysgraphiaawareness  #dyslexia  #dysgraphiaeducation #cheridotterer #learningdisabilities
